text_en: Now concerning the times and the seasons, brothers and sisters, you do not need to have anything written to you.
text_cn: 弟兄们，至论那时候与日期，不需要给你们写什么。

text_en: For you yourselves know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
text_cn: 你们原确实知道：主的日子要像夜间的盗贼一样来到。

text_en: When they say, “There is peace and security, ” then sudden destruction will come upon them, as labor pains come upon a pregnant woman, and there will be no escape!
text_cn: 几时人正说：“平安无事，”那时灭亡会猝然来到他们身上，就像痛苦来到怀孕者身上一样，决逃脱不了。

text_en: But you, beloved, are not in darkness, for that day to surprise you like a thief;
text_cn: 但是你们，弟兄们，你们不是在黑暗中，以致那日子像盗贼一样袭击你们；

text_en: for you are all children of light and children of the day; we are not of the night or of darkness.
text_cn: 你们众人都是光明之子和白日之子；我们不属于黑夜，也不属于黑暗。

text_en: So then let us not fall asleep as others do, but let us keep awake and be sober;
text_cn: 所以我们不当像其他的人一样贪睡，却当醒寤清醒，

text_en: for those who sleep sleep at night, and those who are drunk get drunk at night.
text_cn: 因为人睡觉是黑夜睡觉，喝醉的人是黑夜喝醉；

text_en: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, and put on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet the hope of salvation.
text_cn: 但是我们做白日之子的，应当清醒，穿上信德和爱德作甲，戴上得救的望德作盔，

text_en: For God has destined us not for wrath but for obtaining salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
text_cn: 因为天主没有拣定我们为泄怒，而是藉我们的主耶稣基督为获得拯救，

text_en: who died for us, so that whether we are awake or asleep we may live with him.
text_cn: 他为我们死了，为叫我们不论醒寤或睡眠，都同他一起生活。

text_en: Therefore encourage one another and build up each other, as indeed you are doing.
text_cn: 为此，你们应互相安慰，彼此建树，就如你们所行的。

text_en: But we appeal to you, brothers and sisters, to respect those who labor among you, and have charge of you in the Lord and admonish you;
text_cn: 弟兄们，我们还求你们尊敬那些在你们中劳苦，在主内管理你们和劝戒你们的人，

text_en: esteem them very highly in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.
text_cn: 为了他们的工作，你们更应本着爱，重视他们；你们要彼此平安相处。

text_en: And we urge you, beloved, to admonish the idlers, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, be patient with all of them.
text_cn: 弟兄们，我们还劝勉你们：要劝戒闲荡的，宽慰怯懦的，扶持软弱的，容忍一切人！

text_en: See that none of you repays evil for evil, but always seek to do good to one another and to all.
text_cn: 要小心：人对人不要以恶报恶，却要时常彼此勉励，互相善待，且善待一切人。

text_en: Rejoice always,
text_cn: 应常欢乐，

text_en: pray without ceasing,
text_cn: 不断祈祷，

text_en: give thanks in all circumstances; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.
text_cn: 事事感谢：这就是天主在基督耶稣内对你们所有的旨意。

text_en: Do not quench the Spirit.
text_cn: 不要消灭神恩，

text_en: Do not despise the words of prophets,
text_cn: 不要轻视先知之恩；

text_en: but test everything; hold fast to what is good;
text_cn: 但应当考验一切，好的，应保持；

text_en: abstain from every form of evil.
text_cn: 各种坏的，要远避。

text_en: May the God of peace himself sanctify you entirely; and may your spirit and soul and body be kept sound and blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 愿赐平安的天主亲自完全圣化你们，将你们整个的神魂、灵魂和肉身，在我们的主耶稣基督来临时，保持的无瑕可指：

text_en: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do this.
text_cn: 那召你们的是忠信的，他必实行。

text_en: Beloved, pray for us.
text_cn: 弟兄们，你们也要为我们祈祷。

text_en: Greet all the brothers and sisters with a holy kiss.
text_cn: 你们要以圣吻问候所有的弟兄。

text_en: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all of them.
text_cn: 我因主誓求你们，向众弟兄朗诵这封书信。

text_en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
text_cn: 愿我们的主耶稣基督的恩宠与你们同在！
